title: Project Manager
description:
Ipoteka Bank, part of the international OTP Group, is undergoing a large-scale transformation, including the modernization of its corporate governance. Our newly established Corporate Governance Department brings together the CEO Office, project management and Management Board support functions. Join us and help drive this change at the center of the bank’s strategic decision-making.
Key Responsibilities
Prepare business cases and manage strategic and transformation projects.
Monitor project timelines, milestones, KPIs and business outcomes.
Support the CEO Office: CEO-level priorities.
Track decisions and action items with responsible owners and report on their status.
Support the work of the Management Board and its committees and maintain governance policies in line with regulatory and Group standards.
Prepare reports and presentations for the Management Board and senior stakeholders.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, consultants and partners.
What We’re Looking For
2+ years of experience in consulting, banking, strategy, corporate governance or project management.
Strong analytical skills and a data-driven mindset.
Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; strong business writing.
Fluent English and Russian; Uzbek is a plus.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
